Arabic text: بِسْمِ اللَّـهِ الرَّحْمَـٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ
Translation: In the name of Allah, the Most Beneficent, the Most Merciful

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِ مُحَمَّدٍ
Translation: O Allah, send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad

Arabic text: اَللَّهُمَّ إِنِّيْ أَسْتَخِيرُكَ بِعِلْمِكَ
Translation: O Allah, I seek the best from You through Your knowledge

Arabic text: فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّدٍ وَ آلِهِ وَ اقْضِ لِيْ بِالْخِيَرَةِ
Translation: So send blessings upon Muhammad and his family, and decide for me what is best

Arabic text: وَ أَلْهِمْنَا مَعْرِفَةَ الِاخْتِيَارِ
Translation: And inspire us with the knowledge of making the right choice

Arabic text: وَ اجْعَلْ ذٰلِكَ ذَرِيْعَةً إِلَى الرِّضَا
Translation: And make that a means to being pleased

Arabic text: بِمَا قَضَيْتَ لَنَا وَ التَّسْلِيمِ لِمَا حَكَمْتَ
Translation: With what You have decreed for us and submission to what You have ruled

Arabic text: فَأَزِحْ عَنَّا رَيْبَ الِارْتِيَابِ
Translation: Remove from us the doubt of uncertainty

Arabic text: وَ أَيِّدْنَا بِيَقِينِ الْمُخْلِصِينَ
Translation: And support us with the certainty of the sincere ones

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَسُمْنَا عَجْزَ الْمَعْرِفَةِ عَمَّا تَخَيَّرْتَ
Translation: And do not burden us with the inability to recognize what You have chosen

Arabic text: فَنَغْمِطَ قَدْرَكَ وَ نَكْرَهَ مَوْضِعَ رِضَاكَ
Translation: So that we undervalue Your decree and dislike the place of Your pleasure

Arabic text: وَ نَجْنَحَ إِلَى الَّتِيْ هِيَ أَبْعَدُ مِنْ حُسْنِ الْعَاقِبَةِ
Translation: And incline toward that which is further from a good outcome

Arabic text: وَ أَقْرَبُ إِلَى ضِدِّ الْعَافِيَةِ
Translation: And closer to the opposite of well-being

Arabic text: حَبِّبْ إِلَيْنَا مَا نَكْرَهُ مِنْ قَضَائِكَ
Translation: Make beloved to us what we dislike from Your decree

Arabic text: وَ سَهِّلْ عَلَيْنَا مَا نَسْتَصْعِبُ مِنْ حُكْمِكَ
Translation: And make easy for us what we find difficult from Your ruling

Arabic text: وَ أَلْهِمْنَا الِانْقِيَادَ لِمَا أَوْرَدْتَ عَلَيْنَا مِنْ مَشِيَّتِكَ
Translation: And inspire us to submit to what You bring upon us from Your will

Arabic text: حَتَّى لَا نُحِبَّ تَأْخِيرَ مَا عَجَّلْتَ
Translation: Until we do not wish to delay what You have hastened

Arabic text: وَ لَا تَعْجِيلَ مَا أَخَّرْتَ وَ لَا نَكْرَهَ مَا أَحْبَبْتَ
Translation: Nor hasten what You have delayed, and we do not dislike what You love

Arabic text: وَ لَا نَتَخَيَّرَ مَا كَرِهْتَ
Translation: And we do not choose what You dislike

Arabic text: وَ اخْتِمْ لَنَا بِالَّتِيْ هِيَ أَحْمَدُ عَاقِبَةً وَ أَكْرَمُ مَصِيرًا
Translation: And conclude for us with that which has the most praiseworthy outcome and the most noble destination

Arabic text: إِنَّكَ تُفِيدُ الْكَرِيمَةَ وَ تُعْطِيْ الْجَسِيمَةَ
Translation: Indeed, You bestow the precious and give the magnificent

Arabic text: وَ تَفْعَلُ مَا تُرِيدُ وَ أَنْتَ عَلَى كُلِّ شَيْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
Translation: And You do whatever You will, and You have power over all things
